name: centerfuse-ecosystem
description: CenterFuse product ecosystem, including SellFuse and BuyFuse.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @centerfuse/config && npm run build -w @centerfuse/auth && npm run build -w @centerfuse/platform && npm run build -w @centerfuse/integrations && npm run build -w @sellfuse/types && npm run build -w @sellfuse/validation && npm run build -w @sellfuse/marketplace-adapters && npm run build -w @sellfuse/ai-gateway && npm run build -w @centerfuse/ai && npm run build -w @sellfuse/domain && npm run build -w @centerfuse/database && npm run build -w @centerfuse/buyfuse-domain && npm run build -w @centerfuse/ui
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @sellfuse/api && npm run build -w @sellfuse/ai-gateway-server && npm run build -w @sellfuse/web && npm run build -w @centerfuse/home && npm run build -w @centerfuse/buyfuse
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
